name: tf
description: SDC task-flow — PM-led dev/test/review team. A PM agent plans each task (from a ticket, any link or plain words), staffs dev leads (with dev members), tester and reviewer agents, keeps re-runnable e2e flows and ships ready PRs with evidence. /tf:demo turns a design canvas into a clickable client demo; /tf:digest sums up your Zalo project chats.

interface.shortDescription: A PM agent plans each task, staffs dev, tester and reviewer agents, and ships ready PRs
